name: Slack
summary: Slack apps can act as agents with dedicated surfaces: an agent entry point in the top nav, split view, threaded agent sessions, streamed text and suggested prompts. Apps are built with the Bolt frameworks or the Web and Events APIs, and Slack also runs its own MCP server and a Real-time Search API for agents outside Slack.
